import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


EXPECTED_SOURCE = "a8d9630aa6165a4712c4391651e1c152ba990f34"
EXPECTED_TREE = "87814b40728bfd75fd2620e37fa7d16f2e463e75"
EXPECTED_TESTS = 15
EXPECTED_FAILURES = 8
COMMAND = ["bin/dev", "test", "test/features/domain_cucumber_runner_test.exs"]
OUT = Path(".fabro/tmp/wip-declaration-red-evidence")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES = {
    "one WIP outline is one declaration containing all of its expanded rows",
    "one locally WIP Examples declaration contains all and only its expanded rows",
    "outline-level WIP remains one declaration across separate Examples blocks",
    "separately WIP Examples blocks are separate declarations even on one outline",
    "identical rows in one WIP declaration remain separate executions",
    "inherited feature WIP counts logical scenarios and outlines, not expanded rows",
    "inherited rule WIP counts logical scenarios and outlines, not expanded rows",
    "WIP is still included in ordinary domain regression selection",
}


def utc_now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def write_json(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def git(*args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        check=check,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )


def git_text(*args, optional=False):
    result = git(*args, check=not optional)
    if result.returncode and optional:
        return None
    return result.stdout.decode().strip()


def safe_remote_identity(remote):
    if remote is None:
        return None
    digest = hashlib.sha256(remote.encode()).hexdigest()
    if "://" in remote:
        parsed = urlsplit(remote)
        host = parsed.hostname or "unknown-host"
        if parsed.port is not None:
            host = f"{host}:{parsed.port}"
        host_path = host + parsed.path
    else:
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(?:[^@]+@)?([^:]+):(.+)", remote)
        if match:
            host_path = match.group(1) + "/" + match.group(2).lstrip("/")
        else:
            host_path = "non-network-remote"
    return {"host_path": host_path, "full_url_sha256": digest}


def source_snapshot(label):
    head = git_text("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = git_text("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
    index_tree = git_text("write-tree")
    worktree_diff = git("diff", "--binary").stdout
    index_diff = git("diff", "--cached", "--binary").stdout
    entries = []
    tree_rows = git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", head).stdout
    for row in tree_rows.split(b"\0"):
        if not row:
            continue
        metadata, raw_path = row.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
        if kind != b"blob":
            raise AssertionError(("unsupported tracked entry", os.fsdecode(raw_path), kind.decode()))
        entries.append((mode.decode(), blob, os.fsdecode(raw_path)))

    objects = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "cat-file", "--batch"],
        input=b"\n".join(blob for _, blob, _ in entries) + b"\n",
    )
    stream = io.BytesIO(objects)
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256()
    mismatches = []
    for expected_mode, blob, name in entries:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        if len(header) != 3 or header[0] != blob or header[1] != b"blob":
            raise AssertionError(("bad cat-file header", header, name))
        expected_bytes = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        if stream.read(1) != b"\n":
            raise AssertionError(("bad cat-file separator", name))
        path = Path(name)
        if path.is_symlink():
            actual_mode = "120000"
            actual_bytes = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))
        elif path.exists() and stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode):
            actual_mode = "100755" if path.stat().st_mode & 0o111 else "100644"
            actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()
        else:
            mismatches.append({"path": name, "problem": "missing or unsupported worktree file"})
            continue
        if actual_mode != expected_mode or actual_bytes != expected_bytes:
            mismatches.append({
                "path": name,
                "expected_mode": expected_mode,
                "actual_mode": actual_mode,
                "expected_blob": blob.decode(),
                "actual_sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual_bytes).hexdigest(),
            })
        fingerprint.update(os.fsencode(name) + b"\0" + actual_mode.encode() + b"\0" + actual_bytes)
    if stream.read():
        raise AssertionError("unexpected trailing cat-file output")

    snapshot = {
        "captured_at": utc_now(),
        "head": head,
        "head_tree": tree,
        "index_tree": index_tree,
        "branch_ref": git_text("symbolic-ref", "-q", "HEAD", optional=True),
        "branch_name": git_text("symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD", optional=True),
        "upstream": git_text(
            "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "--symbolic-full-name", "@{upstream}", optional=True
        ),
        "origin_remote": safe_remote_identity(
            git_text("config", "--get", "remote.origin.url", optional=True)
        ),
        "status": git_text("status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal"),
        "tracked_files": len(entries),
        "actual_bytes_modes_sha256": fingerprint.hexdigest(),
        "worktree_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(worktree_diff).hexdigest(),
        "worktree_diff_bytes": len(worktree_diff),
        "index_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(index_diff).hexdigest(),
        "index_diff_bytes": len(index_diff),
        "mismatches": mismatches,
    }
    write_json(f"source-{label}.json", snapshot)
    print("SOURCE_SNAPSHOT " + label + " " + json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return snapshot


def invariant(snapshot):
    return {key: value for key, value in snapshot.items() if key != "captured_at"}


def initial_source_errors(snapshot):
    errors = []
    if snapshot["head"] != EXPECTED_SOURCE:
        errors.append("HEAD does not equal approved source")
    if snapshot["head_tree"] != EXPECTED_TREE:
        errors.append("HEAD tree does not equal approved tree")
    if snapshot["index_tree"] != EXPECTED_TREE:
        errors.append("index tree does not equal approved tree")
    if snapshot["worktree_diff_bytes"] != 0:
        errors.append("tracked worktree diff is not empty")
    if snapshot["index_diff_bytes"] != 0:
        errors.append("tracked index diff is not empty")
    if snapshot["mismatches"]:
        errors.append("tracked worktree bytes or modes do not match HEAD")
    return errors


def mirror_stream(source, sink, mirror):
    while True:
        chunk = source.read(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        sink.write(chunk)
        sink.flush()
        mirror.write(chunk)
        mirror.flush()


def run_focused_command():
    stdout_path = OUT / "focused-command.stdout.log"
    stderr_path = OUT / "focused-command.stderr.log"
    started_at = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    error = None
    try:
        with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout_log, stderr_path.open("wb") as stderr_log:
            process = subprocess.Popen(COMMAND, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            stdout_thread = threading.Thread(
                target=mirror_stream,
                args=(process.stdout, stdout_log, sys.stdout.buffer),
            )
            stderr_thread = threading.Thread(
                target=mirror_stream,
                args=(process.stderr, stderr_log, sys.stderr.buffer),
            )
            stdout_thread.start()
            stderr_thread.start()
            exit_code = process.wait()
            stdout_thread.join()
            stderr_thread.join()
    except OSError as exception:
        exit_code = 127
        error = f"{type(exception).__name__}: {exception}"
        stderr_path.write_text(error + "\n")
        if not stdout_path.exists():
            stdout_path.write_bytes(b"")
        print(error, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

    result = {
        "name": "focused-domain-cucumber-runner-test",
        "argv": COMMAND,
        "started_at": started_at,
        "finished_at": utc_now(),
        "duration_ms": round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
        "exit": exit_code,
        "stdout": str(stdout_path),
        "stderr": str(stderr_path),
    }
    if error is not None:
        result["error"] = error
    write_json("command-result.json", result)
    print("COMMAND_EXIT " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return result


def parse_test_result():
    raw = (OUT / "focused-command.stdout.log").read_text(errors="replace")
    raw += "\n" + (OUT / "focused-command.stderr.log").read_text(errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", raw)
    names = re.findall(
        r"(?m)^\s*\d+\)\s+test\s+(.+?)\s+\(Memba\.DomainCucumberRunnerTest\)\s*$",
        text,
    )
    summaries = re.findall(r"(?m)(\d+)\s+tests?,\s+(\d+)\s+failures?", text)
    tests = int(summaries[-1][0]) if summaries else None
    failures = int(summaries[-1][1]) if summaries else None
    expected_names = sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES)
    actual_names = sorted(names)
    return {
        "tests": tests,
        "failures": failures,
        "failure_names": actual_names,
        "expected_failure_names": expected_names,
        "missing_expected_failures": sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES.difference(names)),
        "unexpected_failures": sorted(set(names).difference(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES)),
        "exact_expected_failures": (
            tests == EXPECTED_TESTS
            and failures == EXPECTED_FAILURES
            and actual_names == expected_names
        ),
    }


def main():
    write_json("owner.json", {
        "source": EXPECTED_SOURCE,
        "tree": EXPECTED_TREE,
        "purpose": "expected-tdd-red-for-wip-declaration-granularity",
        "model_nodes": 0,
        "command": COMMAND,
    })

    before = source_snapshot("before")
    admission_errors = initial_source_errors(before)
    command_result = None
    if admission_errors:
        print("SOURCE_ADMISSION_FAILED " + json.dumps(admission_errors), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    else:
        command_result = run_focused_command()

    after = source_snapshot("after")
    source_unchanged = invariant(before) == invariant(after)
    after_errors = initial_source_errors(after)
    parsed = parse_test_result() if command_result is not None else {
        "tests": None,
        "failures": None,
        "failure_names": [],
        "expected_failure_names": sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES),
        "missing_expected_failures": sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES),
        "unexpected_failures": [],
        "exact_expected_failures": False,
    }
    desired_red = bool(
        command_result is not None
        and command_result["exit"] != 0
        and parsed["exact_expected_failures"]
        and not admission_errors
        and not after_errors
        and source_unchanged
    )
    final = {
        "purpose": "expected-tdd-red-for-wip-declaration-granularity",
        "source": EXPECTED_SOURCE,
        "tree": EXPECTED_TREE,
        "command": command_result,
        "parsed_test_result": parsed,
        "desired_tdd_red": desired_red,
        "admission_errors": admission_errors,
        "after_errors": after_errors,
        "source_unchanged": source_unchanged,
        "before_fingerprint": before["actual_bytes_modes_sha256"],
        "after_fingerprint": after["actual_bytes_modes_sha256"],
    }
    write_json("final-diagnostics.json", final)
    write_json("source-comparison.json", {
        "source": EXPECTED_SOURCE,
        "tree": EXPECTED_TREE,
        "unchanged": source_unchanged,
        "before": invariant(before),
        "after": invariant(after),
    })
    print("TDD_RED_SUMMARY " + json.dumps(final, sort_keys=True), flush=True)

    if admission_errors or after_errors or not source_unchanged:
        return 90
    if command_result["exit"] != 0:
        return command_result["exit"]
    return 0 if desired_red else 86


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


EXPECTED_SOURCE = "a8d9630aa6165a4712c4391651e1c152ba990f34"
EXPECTED_TREE = "87814b40728bfd75fd2620e37fa7d16f2e463e75"
EXPECTED_TESTS = 15
EXPECTED_FAILURES = 8
COMMAND = ["bin/dev", "test", "test/features/domain_cucumber_runner_test.exs"]
OUT = Path(".fabro/tmp/wip-declaration-red-evidence")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES = {
    "one WIP outline is one declaration containing all of its expanded rows",
    "one locally WIP Examples declaration contains all and only its expanded rows",
    "outline-level WIP remains one declaration across separate Examples blocks",
    "separately WIP Examples blocks are separate declarations even on one outline",
    "identical rows in one WIP declaration remain separate executions",
    "inherited feature WIP counts logical scenarios and outlines, not expanded rows",
    "inherited rule WIP counts logical scenarios and outlines, not expanded rows",
    "WIP is still included in ordinary domain regression selection",
}


def utc_now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def write_json(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def git(*args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        check=check,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )


def git_text(*args, optional=False):
    result = git(*args, check=not optional)
    if result.returncode and optional:
        return None
    return result.stdout.decode().strip()


def safe_remote_identity(remote):
    if remote is None:
        return None
    digest = hashlib.sha256(remote.encode()).hexdigest()
    if "://" in remote:
        parsed = urlsplit(remote)
        host = parsed.hostname or "unknown-host"
        if parsed.port is not None:
            host = f"{host}:{parsed.port}"
        host_path = host + parsed.path
    else:
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(?:[^@]+@)?([^:]+):(.+)", remote)
        if match:
            host_path = match.group(1) + "/" + match.group(2).lstrip("/")
        else:
            host_path = "non-network-remote"
    return {"host_path": host_path, "full_url_sha256": digest}


def source_snapshot(label):
    head = git_text("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = git_text("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
    index_tree = git_text("write-tree")
    worktree_diff = git("diff", "--binary").stdout
    index_diff = git("diff", "--cached", "--binary").stdout
    entries = []
    tree_rows = git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", head).stdout
    for row in tree_rows.split(b"\0"):
        if not row:
            continue
        metadata, raw_path = row.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
        if kind != b"blob":
            raise AssertionError(("unsupported tracked entry", os.fsdecode(raw_path), kind.decode()))
        entries.append((mode.decode(), blob, os.fsdecode(raw_path)))

    objects = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "cat-file", "--batch"],
        input=b"\n".join(blob for _, blob, _ in entries) + b"\n",
    )
    stream = io.BytesIO(objects)
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256()
    mismatches = []
    for expected_mode, blob, name in entries:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        if len(header) != 3 or header[0] != blob or header[1] != b"blob":
            raise AssertionError(("bad cat-file header", header, name))
        expected_bytes = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        if stream.read(1) != b"\n":
            raise AssertionError(("bad cat-file separator", name))
        path = Path(name)
        if path.is_symlink():
            actual_mode = "120000"
            actual_bytes = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path))
        elif path.exists() and stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode):
            actual_mode = "100755" if path.stat().st_mode & 0o111 else "100644"
            actual_bytes = path.read_bytes()
        else:
            mismatches.append({"path": name, "problem": "missing or unsupported worktree file"})
            continue
        if actual_mode != expected_mode or actual_bytes != expected_bytes:
            mismatches.append({
                "path": name,
                "expected_mode": expected_mode,
                "actual_mode": actual_mode,
                "expected_blob": blob.decode(),
                "actual_sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual_bytes).hexdigest(),
            })
        fingerprint.update(os.fsencode(name) + b"\0" + actual_mode.encode() + b"\0" + actual_bytes)
    if stream.read():
        raise AssertionError("unexpected trailing cat-file output")

    snapshot = {
        "captured_at": utc_now(),
        "head": head,
        "head_tree": tree,
        "index_tree": index_tree,
        "branch_ref": git_text("symbolic-ref", "-q", "HEAD", optional=True),
        "branch_name": git_text("symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD", optional=True),
        "upstream": git_text(
            "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "--symbolic-full-name", "@{upstream}", optional=True
        ),
        "origin_remote": safe_remote_identity(
            git_text("config", "--get", "remote.origin.url", optional=True)
        ),
        "status": git_text("status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal"),
        "tracked_files": len(entries),
        "actual_bytes_modes_sha256": fingerprint.hexdigest(),
        "worktree_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(worktree_diff).hexdigest(),
        "worktree_diff_bytes": len(worktree_diff),
        "index_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(index_diff).hexdigest(),
        "index_diff_bytes": len(index_diff),
        "mismatches": mismatches,
    }
    write_json(f"source-{label}.json", snapshot)
    print("SOURCE_SNAPSHOT " + label + " " + json.dumps(snapshot, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return snapshot


def invariant(snapshot):
    return {key: value for key, value in snapshot.items() if key != "captured_at"}


def initial_source_errors(snapshot):
    errors = []
    if snapshot["head"] != EXPECTED_SOURCE:
        errors.append("HEAD does not equal approved source")
    if snapshot["head_tree"] != EXPECTED_TREE:
        errors.append("HEAD tree does not equal approved tree")
    if snapshot["index_tree"] != EXPECTED_TREE:
        errors.append("index tree does not equal approved tree")
    if snapshot["worktree_diff_bytes"] != 0:
        errors.append("tracked worktree diff is not empty")
    if snapshot["index_diff_bytes"] != 0:
        errors.append("tracked index diff is not empty")
    if snapshot["mismatches"]:
        errors.append("tracked worktree bytes or modes do not match HEAD")
    return errors


def mirror_stream(source, sink, mirror):
    while True:
        chunk = source.read(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        sink.write(chunk)
        sink.flush()
        mirror.write(chunk)
        mirror.flush()


def run_focused_command():
    stdout_path = OUT / "focused-command.stdout.log"
    stderr_path = OUT / "focused-command.stderr.log"
    started_at = utc_now()
    started = time.monotonic()
    error = None
    try:
        with stdout_path.open("wb") as stdout_log, stderr_path.open("wb") as stderr_log:
            process = subprocess.Popen(COMMAND, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            stdout_thread = threading.Thread(
                target=mirror_stream,
                args=(process.stdout, stdout_log, sys.stdout.buffer),
            )
            stderr_thread = threading.Thread(
                target=mirror_stream,
                args=(process.stderr, stderr_log, sys.stderr.buffer),
            )
            stdout_thread.start()
            stderr_thread.start()
            exit_code = process.wait()
            stdout_thread.join()
            stderr_thread.join()
    except OSError as exception:
        exit_code = 127
        error = f"{type(exception).__name__}: {exception}"
        stderr_path.write_text(error + "\n")
        if not stdout_path.exists():
            stdout_path.write_bytes(b"")
        print(error, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

    result = {
        "name": "focused-domain-cucumber-runner-test",
        "argv": COMMAND,
        "started_at": started_at,
        "finished_at": utc_now(),
        "duration_ms": round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
        "exit": exit_code,
        "stdout": str(stdout_path),
        "stderr": str(stderr_path),
    }
    if error is not None:
        result["error"] = error
    write_json("command-result.json", result)
    print("COMMAND_EXIT " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return result


def parse_test_result():
    raw = (OUT / "focused-command.stdout.log").read_text(errors="replace")
    raw += "\n" + (OUT / "focused-command.stderr.log").read_text(errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", raw)
    names = re.findall(
        r"(?m)^\s*\d+\)\s+test\s+(.+?)\s+\(Memba\.DomainCucumberRunnerTest\)\s*$",
        text,
    )
    summaries = re.findall(r"(?m)(\d+)\s+tests?,\s+(\d+)\s+failures?", text)
    tests = int(summaries[-1][0]) if summaries else None
    failures = int(summaries[-1][1]) if summaries else None
    expected_names = sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES)
    actual_names = sorted(names)
    return {
        "tests": tests,
        "failures": failures,
        "failure_names": actual_names,
        "expected_failure_names": expected_names,
        "missing_expected_failures": sorted(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES.difference(names)),
        "unexpected_failures": sorted(set(names).difference(EXPECTED_FAILURE_NAMES)),
        "exact_expected_failures": (
            tests == EXPECTED_TESTS
            and failures == EXPECTED_FAILURES
            and actual_names == expected_names
        ),
    }


def main():

    if remote is None:
